aviso.body:
In compliance with Law 34/2002 of 11 July on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), users are informed of the identification details of the owner of this website.

- Domain: opogenai.com

## 2. Purpose of the website

OpoGen AI is a digital educational platform that uses artificial intelligence to generate tests, summaries and personalised study material from notes or topics provided by users.

Access to the website grants the status of user and implies acceptance of this Legal Notice, the Privacy Policy and the terms of use of the service.

## 3. Access and use conditions

Users undertake to use the website and its services lawfully, diligently and respectfully, refraining from any activity that may damage the operation of the platform, affect other users or infringe the rights of third parties.

Unauthorised automated access, mass extraction of content, introduction of malicious code and any use that may compromise the security or availability of the service are prohibited. Users are responsible for safeguarding their access credentials.

## 4. Intellectual and industrial property

All proprietary content on this website — texts, designs, logos, source code, structure, images and graphic elements — is owned by Manuel Pujante Noguera or used with authorisation. Reproduction, distribution, public communication or transformation without express written authorisation is prohibited.

Notes and files uploaded by users belong to the person who provides them. The platform uses them solely to provide the requested service, in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

## 5. Liability

Tests and content generated by artificial intelligence are study support tools and do not guarantee success in official examinations or replace the judgement of a professional. The owner is not liable for the use made of such content.

Continuous availability of the service and the absence of technical errors are not guaranteed, although reasonable measures will be taken to restore operation and minimise incidents.

## 6. Third-party links

The website may include links to third-party services, such as the Stripe payment gateway or artificial intelligence providers. The owner does not control these services and accepts no liability for their content, privacy policies or terms of use.

## 7. Data protection

The processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy, which forms part of this Legal Notice.

## 8. Cookies

Information about cookies and equivalent technologies is available in the Cookies and local storage section of the Privacy Policy.

## 9. Applicable law and jurisdiction

The relationship between the owner and the user is governed by Spanish law. For the resolution of disputes, the parties submit to the Courts and Tribunals of Albacete, unless applicable regulations establish another forum.

For any query relating to this Legal Notice, you may write to soporte@opogenai.com.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.description: OpoGen AI Privacy Policy: controller, purposes, legal basis, recipients, retention, cookies and rights.
privacidad.body:
At OpoGen AI we process personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD). This policy explains what data we collect, for what purpose, for how long and how you can exercise your rights.

## 1. Data controller

- Identity: Manuel Pujante Noguera
- Tax ID (NIF): 27457112B
- Address: Calle Gracia
- Email: soporte@opogenai.com

## 2. Data we collect

- Registration data: name, surname, telephone number and email address.
- Billing data: identity document, address, city, province, country and postcode, for Premium users only.
- Usage data: tests, results, study statistics and files you upload to the platform.
- Technical data: session and CSRF cookies, theme preference and anonymous analytics identifiers.

## 3. Purposes of processing

- To create, verify and manage your user account.
- To send verification and password recovery emails and other necessary service communications.
- To generate tests, summaries, statistics and other requested features.
- To manage payments, subscriptions, billing and tax obligations.
- To prevent fraud, abuse and unauthorised access and to maintain platform security.
- To produce aggregated usage statistics and improve the service.

## 4. Legal basis

- Performance of a contract: to manage your account and provide the requested services.
- Consent: for certain communications and optional data processing.
- Compliance with a legal obligation: for billing, accounting and tax obligations.
- Legitimate interest: for security, abuse prevention and service improvement, provided your rights do not prevail.

## 5. Recipients and providers

We do not sell your data. To provide the service we use providers acting as processors or independent controllers:

- Stripe: payment and subscription processing. Card details are handled directly by Stripe.
- DeepSeek: question generation and text processing.
- Gemini: artificial intelligence generation and checks.
- Resend: transactional verification and recovery emails.
- Groq: backup artificial intelligence provider, where used.
- Hetzner: hosting of the application and files on our own servers.

Some providers may be located outside the European Economic Area. In such cases, contractual safeguards and equivalent measures are applied in accordance with the GDPR.

## 6. Retention period

- Account data is retained while the account remains active and for applicable legal periods.
- Billing data is retained for the period required by tax law, generally five years.
- If a Premium account becomes Freemium, files are retained for 30 days and then deleted.
- Anonymous analytics data is retained for a limited period and cannot identify the individual.
- Backups are retained for the period necessary to ensure service recovery.

## 7. File storage

Files you upload are stored on own servers contracted with Hetzner, within a persistent application volume. Each account has its own folder and its files are not mixed with those of other users.

To generate questions, we send artificial intelligence providers only the text necessary for the requested task. We do not transfer the complete file or use your notes for advertising purposes.

## 8. Cookies and local storage

We use cookies and equivalent technologies strictly necessary for the operation of the service:

- Session cookie: keeps you signed in and is essential to access your account.
- CSRF cookie: protects forms against unauthorised requests.
- Theme preference: remembers whether you use light or dark mode.
- Session storage: we use sessionStorage for an anonymous analytics identifier and to remember your email during the payment flow. It is deleted when you close the tab.
- Stripe cookies: may be set during the payment process on the Stripe domain.

We do not use advertising or profiling cookies. You can configure or delete cookies in your browser, although blocking essential cookies may prevent access to your account.

## 9. User rights

You may exercise the following rights:

- Access to your personal data.
- Rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data.
- Erasure of your data when it is no longer necessary.
- Restriction of or objection to processing.
- Portability of your data in a structured format.
- Withdrawal of consent at any time.
- Complaint to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).

To exercise them, write to soporte@opogenai.com stating the right you wish to exercise and providing the information necessary to identify you.

## 10. Security

We apply technical and organisational measures to protect information: Argon2id passwords, CSRF protection, attempt limits, server access control and backups. No system is completely infallible, so we recommend safeguarding your password and not sharing it.

## 11. Minors and Kids Zone

The Kids Zone is aimed at children aged 3 to 12. If a minor registers, it is presumed that they have the consent of their parents or legal guardians. If you are a guardian and detect a minor's data without authorisation, you can request its deletion at soporte@opogenai.com.

## 12. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to adapt it to legislative or service changes. We will publish the current version with its update date and, where the change is relevant, communicate it through the usual channels.
